_help: Generated by tools/theme_arcade_painted.py — do not edit by hand. Magnet Mayhem's UiTheme variation name → the gohud_arcade_light variation that carries exactly its items and values. _font_sizes._help: No font is written. The font sizes written are the game's literal ones or a Cfg size's desktop value (named in _cfg_sizes).

_cfg_sizes._help: Values that are a Cfg size in the game, written at their desktop value; the game swaps in the touch value itself.

_base_types._help: Base types this shape styles as the game does (the game pins base types itself).
